description.narrative: The Government of Ghana (GoG) is pursuing the diversification of the economy by identifying priority sectors for inclusive and transformational growth and working to attract private sector investment into them. This is intended to spur industrialisation through manufacturing and in-country value-addition. The JET programme is an industrialisation-focused initiative aligned with this objective and the GoG’s vision to move ‘Ghana beyond Aid’. The programme also seeks to strengthen partnerships and increase investment flows between the UK and Ghana and is a catalyst for a new strategic economic development partnership between the two countries. The programme also forms part of the strategic dialogue between the two countries on trade and economic development known as the UK-Ghana Business Council (UKGBC), co-Chaired by the Vice President of Ghana and the UK Minister for Africa.
